desc:
One tank of fuel. Five kilometers of road. Everything dead in between.

Floor it. Every zombie you flatten pays, and every meter you cover pays more — but when the tank runs dry, that's the run. Take what you earned back to the garage, bolt something heavier onto your car, and go again. Further this time.

🚗 9 CARS — from the gutless Buggy to the road-clearing Last Stop
🔧 6 UPGRADES — engine, fuel, armor, tires, turret mount, booster mount
🔫 9 TURRETS — shotgun, sniper, dual minigun, laser cannon, rocket launcher
🔥 11 BOOSTERS — nitro clusters, jet pods, and a ram scoop for one last shove
📦 5 CASES — cracked open on the road for gear you can't buy
🏁 CHECKPOINTS — unlock them, restart from them, push past them
🏆 LEADERBOARDS — best streak, total earned, time on the road

Ramp it. Smash through it. Shoot it. Just don't stop.
